configuration: clang -std=c11 -O2, exact finddpos/movement enum, first-success shift and deterministic rn1 adapters; source closure checks pinned C and JS files through Node24.19.0 and git
limitations: Unreachable only from the pinned repository C/JS call sites. External callers, instrumented calls, memory corruption, changed configuration/visibility and future source changes are excluded. No general suppression of illegal-direction diagnostics.

The source audit strips comments/string literals, verifies all identifier occurrences and each fixed call argument, and rejects changed source hashes. It also checks tracked C/header references for the symbol. This is a source closure proof, not an assumption that a small random sample failed to reach the diagnostic.

Exact C finddpos uses deterministic rn1 and first-success finddpos_shift adapters to isolate switch dispatch. No room geometry, irregular-room search, retry/fallback order, RNG generator, corridor placement or runtime parity claim.

Invalid-direction controls deliberately bypass production callers only to establish that the oracle catches the diagnostic; they are not classified as supported gameplay setups or divergences. JS runtime calls are not forced through a private export.
